31091.a:
**Paket menejer — repo'dan yuklaydi, bog'liqlikni hal qiladi.**

```sh
# Debian/Ubuntu
apt update && apt install -y nginx
apt remove nginx; apt purge nginx   # purge: config ham
# RHEL/Fedora
dnf install -y nginx
dnf remove nginx
```

- Alpine — `apk`, Arch — `pacman`.

31092.a:
**`update` — ro'yxatni yangila; `upgrade` — paketlarni yangila.**

- `apt upgrade` — paket o'chirmaydi.
- `apt full-upgrade` — kerak bo'lsa o'chiradi/yangisini qo'shadi.
- dnf'da `dnf check-update` / `dnf upgrade`; metadata avtomatik.

31093.a:
**dpkg/rpm — lokal paket; apt/dnf — ular ustidagi resolver.**

```sh
dpkg -l | grep nginx     # o'rnatilganlar
dpkg -L nginx            # paket fayllari
dpkg -S /usr/sbin/nginx  # fayl qaysi paketdan
rpm -qa; rpm -ql nginx; rpm -qf /usr/sbin/nginx
apt install ./pkg.deb    # lokal faylni dependency bilan
```

31094.a:
**Imzo — paket haqiqatan repo egasidan ekanini kafolatlaydi.**

```sh
curl -fsSL https://example.com/key.gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/ex.gpg
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/ex.gpg] https://example.com/apt stable main" \
  > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ex.list
```

- `apt-key add` deprecated — kalit hamma repo'ga ishonchli bo'lib qolardi.
- dnf: `/etc/yum.repos.d/*.repo`, `gpgcheck=1`.

31095.a:
**Kutilmagan upgrade'dan himoya:**

```sh
apt install postgresql-16=16.4-1.pgdg22.04+1
apt-mark hold postgresql-16
apt-mark unhold postgresql-16
dnf install 'dnf-command(versionlock)'; dnf versionlock add kernel
```

- Docker'da: `apt-get install -y pkg=ver` — reproducible build.

31096.a:
**Bitta layer: update + install + cleanup.**

```dockerfile
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```

- Alohida `RUN apt-get update` — keshlanadi, eskirgan indeks bilan install.
- `apt` emas `apt-get` — skript uchun barqaror interfeys.
- `DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive`.

31097.a:
**Dinamik linker `.so` ni topa olmayapti.**

```sh
ldd /usr/local/bin/app | grep 'not found'
apt-file search libssl.so.3   # qaysi paketda
ldconfig -p | grep ssl
```

- Custom yo'l: `/etc/ld.so.conf.d/x.conf` + `ldconfig`.
- `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` — vaqtinchalik; prod'da qochish.
- Go static binar — muammo yo'q (CGO_ENABLED=0).

31098.a:
**Bundled vs shared.**

- Distro (.deb/.rpm) — kutubxona bitta, CVE patch bir joyda.
- Snap — Canonical store, auto-update, squashfs mount.
- Flatpak — desktop, runtime'lar.
- AppImage — bitta fayl, o'rnatishsiz.
- Serverda: distro paket yoki container.

31099.a:
**Ikki paket bitta kutubxonaning mos kelmaydigan versiyasini talab qiladi.**

- SemVer: MAJOR — buzuvchi, MINOR — yangi funksiya, PATCH — fix.
- Yechimlar:
  - Lock fayl (`go.sum`, `package-lock.json`).
  - Izolyatsiya: container, venv.
  - Distro'da: bir nechta major parallel (`libssl1.1` + `libssl3`) — soname.
- Go: MVS (minimal version selection) — deterministik.

31100.a:
**Tez patch vs barqarorlik.**

- `unattended-upgrades` (Debian), `dnf-automatic` (RHEL).
- Faqat `-security` origin.
- Canary: avval bitta guruh serverda.
- Kernel/libc: reboot kerak — `needrestart`, `/var/run/reboot-required`; livepatch.
- Immutable infra: yangi image build, eski node'larni almashtir.

31101.a:
**Tashqi internetga bog'liqlikni kesish.**

- Vositalar: Artifactory, Nexus, aptly, Pulp, Athens (Go proxy).
- Foyda: offline build, snapshot (bugungi repo holati), skanerlash, tezlik.
- Supply chain: dependency confusion — internal nom public'da ham bo'lsa, scope/priority sozla.

31102.a:
**Ishonch zanjiri: manba → build → artefakt → deploy.**

- Hash pin: `go.sum`, `pip --require-hashes`.
- Imzo: GPG repo, `cosign` image.
- SBOM (Syft) + CVE skan (Grype/Trivy) CI'da.
- SLSA provenance — artefakt qaysi commit/CI'dan.
- Distroless/minimal base — kam paket, kam hujum yuzasi.
- Misol: xz-utils backdoor (2024) — upstream maintainer darajasida.
